lessons.symptom: Repeated commits advanced state that should have been idempotent.
lessons.root_cause: Trial state was written directly into the committed record.
lessons.fix: Separate trial state from committed state and promote only accepted transitions.
lessons.prevention: tests/engine/test_interface_commit.py asserts that repeated commits do not advance state.
lessons.notes: Conformance anchor for the exact-required behaviour; prose is normative and must not be summarized.

lessons.symptom: Enqueue order varied between runs on the same input.
lessons.root_cause: The scheduler iterated an unordered mapping.
lessons.fix: Sort the pending set on a total key before enqueueing.
lessons.prevention: tests/engine/test_scheduler_order.py asserts a deterministic enqueue order.
lessons.notes: Conformance anchor for load_with coactivation; related must stay ['L003'].

lessons.symptom: Draining the queue left items behind when a consumer raised.
lessons.root_cause: The drain loop mutated the queue while iterating it.
lessons.fix: Drain from a snapshot and re-queue only unconsumed items.
lessons.prevention: tests/engine/test_queue_drain.py asserts that drain consumes every queued item.
lessons.notes: Reached only through L002.related; never routed directly by the conformance requests.

lessons.symptom: Untrusted lesson prose reached the rendered summary unescaped.
lessons.root_cause: The renderer interpolated raw text into markup.
lessons.fix: Escape every interpolated field at the render boundary.
lessons.prevention: tools/report/test_render.py asserts that summary rendering escapes untrusted text.
lessons.notes: Conformance anchor for advisory selection; reachable only by the akms_tags advisory path.

lessons.symptom: A failed flush left a truncated file on disk.
lessons.root_cause: The writer opened the destination for truncation before the payload was complete.
lessons.fix: Write a sibling temporary file and atomically replace the destination.
lessons.prevention: tests/storage/test_writer_flush.py asserts that a failed flush leaves the prior file intact.
lessons.notes: Conformance anchor for post-diff-only discovery; never declared in pre-task scope.

lessons.symptom: The published architecture note kept describing a contract the engine no longer honoured.
lessons.root_cause: The document was not part of any review checklist tied to the contract it described.
lessons.fix: Bind the document to the contract's own review step so the two move together.
lessons.prevention: docs/architecture.md is re-reviewed whenever the engine contract changes.
lessons.notes: Conformance anchor for documentation-only route suppression. location.file is a docs path, so AKMS drops it from the exact-required lane whenever EVERY declared/changed path in a task is documentation. Do not change this file path.
